name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense
summary: A transferable writ requests one Elixir of Defense and gives a delivery location and payment details. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Written Request
sections.body: The note is penned in faded ink, and the writ can pass from hand to hand. It asks for one Elixir of Defense and gives details for delivery and payment. To complete the exchange, you need the writ in your possession and must bring the requested item to the marked location.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one Elixir of Defense.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the elixir?
faq.answer: The writ's marked location gives the delivery destination.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ in your possession to complete the exchange.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.
